base_address: Not applicable in the same sense as a memory-mapped peripheral. MODBUS organizes server-side state as four logical tables (Discrete Inputs, Coils, Input Registers, Holding Registers), each independently addressed 0..65535 in the PDU. The user-visible numbering of each item is PDU_address + 1.
register_count: Up to 65536 per table × 4 tables = 262144 logical items; actual deployment is application-defined and almost always a small subset.

data_tables.name: Discrete Inputs
data_tables.typical_source: Physical input lines, sensor digital outputs, status flags from an I/O system.

data_tables.name: Coils
data_tables.typical_source: Application-program-alterable on/off outputs (relay drives, mode flags).

data_tables.name: Input Registers
data_tables.typical_source: ADC results, scaled-engineering-unit measurements, status words from an I/O system.

data_tables.name: Holding Registers
function_codes: 0x18 Read FIFO Queue (FIFO pointer is a holding-register address)
data_tables.typical_source: Set-points, configuration words, computed quantities; application-program-alterable.

registers.name: MBAP_TRANSACTION_ID
registers.description: Identification of a MODBUS Request/Response transaction. Set by the client, echoed by the server, so the client may pipeline multiple outstanding transactions on a single TCP connection.

registers.name: MBAP_LENGTH
registers.description: Number of following bytes = 1 (Unit ID) + len(PDU).

registers.name: MBAP_UNIT_ID
registers.description: Identifies a server on a sub-network behind a gateway. 0xFF / 0x00 when the TCP endpoint is itself the MODBUS server.

registers.name: EXCEPTION_CODE
registers.description: 1=Illegal Function, 2=Illegal Data Address, 3=Illegal Data Value, 4=Server Failure, 5=Acknowledge, 6=Busy, 8=Memory Parity Error, 0x0A=Gateway Path Unavailable, 0x0B=Gateway Target Failed.

registers.name: RTU_CRC
registers.description: CRC-16-Modbus (polynomial 0xA001 reflected; init 0xFFFF). Low byte transmitted first.

registers.name: ASCII_LRC
registers.description: Longitudinal Redundancy Check over Address + Function + Data, encoded as 2 ASCII-hex characters.

registers.name: MEI_TYPE
registers.description: 0x0D = CANopen General Reference; 0x0E = Read Device Identification.

notes: MODBUS is a protocol, not a chip; the 'register map' here describes the canonical fields that appear on the wire (in the ADU / PDU framing) and the four logical data-table address spaces the server exposes to the client. An implementing IP core will choose which subset of the four tables to populate and how to mirror them into the host CPU's address space.
